title: about
subtitle: a little bit more about me :)
paragraphs: born in inner mongolia. kindergarten in beijing, primary school in chengdu, middle and high school in shanghai, university and now work in hong kong — five cities, one habit of noticing how things are run.
off the clock: badminton and tennis, pour-over coffee, classical guitar, and a camera on most days. at home, a blue-and-white british shorthair called zai zai (崽崽) supervises all of the above.
photosIntro: the film strips are the evidence.
